name: Graphify-Labs/graphify — 94.4K Stars; Knowledge Graph for Any Codebase; 70x Cost Cut on Large Projects
hook: Turns any codebase—plus docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs—into a queryable knowledge graph using local deterministic AST parsing (tree-sitter, 158 languages). Installs a CLAUDE.md directive and a PreToolUse hook so Claude Code consults the graph before every file-search call; also exposes 15 MCP tools for path tracing, dead-code detection, and architecture analysis. MindStudio benchmarks show up to 70x cost reduction on 500+ file projects. v0.9.25 released July 22, 2026, adding automatic diff-impact analysis and Figma-node support. 94.4K stars, 9.1K forks; works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI.
install: uv tool install graphifyy && graphify install

name: Anthropic 'Record a Skill' — Teach Claude by Recording Your Screen (Pro/Max/Team, July 21)

name: thedotmack/claude-mem — 88.3K Stars; Persistent Memory Across Sessions; 5 Hooks + SQLite + Chroma; v13.12.2 Today
hook: Solves session amnesia: five lifecycle hooks (SessionStart, PostToolUse, Stop, UserPromptSubmit, SessionEnd) capture every tool use, file read, and edit; a local Bun worker compresses observations via Claude Agent SDK and stores them in SQLite with full-text search and Chroma for hybrid semantic/keyword retrieval. Future sessions surface relevant memories with visible token costs via the mem-search skill's 'progressive disclosure' system so you control what you pay for. v13.12.2 shipped today (July 23, 2026); 88.3K stars, up from 46.1K in May. One-liner install.

name: JuliusBrussee/caveman — 92.3K Stars; 65% Fewer Output Tokens; Caveman-Speak, Full Technical Accuracy
hook: A Claude Code skill (and plugin for 30+ other agents) that compresses agent responses into terse caveman-speak without losing any technical accuracy—code, commands, and error messages remain byte-for-byte exact, only the prose is stripped. Benchmarked at 65% average output token reduction (range: 22–87% across 1,200 test scenarios); note that output tokens are typically 1–2% of a Claude Code bill, so the gains are largest for output-heavy workflows or high-volume automation. The original Reddit post got 10K upvotes. One-liner install; v1.9.1. 92.3K stars, 5.2K forks.

name: Claude Code v2.1.218 — /code-review Runs in Background; context:fork Skills Auto-Background; Boolean Frontmatter
hook: v2.1.218 (July 22) moves /code-review to a background subagent, keeping your active conversation clear while reviews run. Skills declared with `context: fork` now start in background by default. New: `yes`/`no`/`on`/`off`/`1`/`0` (case-insensitive) accepted as booleans in skill/plugin frontmatter, eliminating a common authoring friction point. Also adds a periodic progress heartbeat for long-running tool calls, a left-arrow confirmation before discarding conversation, and fixes for deeply nested directory crashes and spurious '[Request interrupted by user]' messages.
